steps.content:
"La... la la... la..."
The girl hums softly in the darkness. The intermittent notes echo across the silent interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It's the Chief! Cough cough...

options: Are you alright? Are you feeling unwell?
Please bear with me, the interrogation will end soon.

choices.text: Are you alright? Are you feeling unwell?
Please bear with me, the interrogation will end soon.

steps.content: Victoria has been kept in a sterile ward for medical reasons. Maybe she's not used to the air in the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I'm alright Chief. Don't worry...
Victoria's voice is still feeble, but it sounds like her breathing has stabilized.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It's because I'm too excited to be locked in the interrogation room. I couldn't catch my breath for a while.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Bear with you? Why do you phrase it like that?
The interrogation room is not as hygienic as the sterile ward you were in. I take it that you're a bit uncomfortable here?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Sorry for making you worry, Chief, but Victoria isn't that weak... cough cough...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It's because I... I'm too excited to be locked in the interrogation room. I couldn't control my breath for a while.
People are usually nervous and frightened to be interrogated one-on-one like this.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: What is there to be nervous about?
She smiles and looks around.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: A confined space, a room full of monitoring equipment... this all must mean that you love me, Chief.
Love?
Of all the Sinners you've encountered, few used such warm, sentimental terms.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That's right. "Love" is an apt word to describe someone who uses everything at their disposal to guard another like a caged bird...
She utters these absurd words with a calm, matter-of-fact tone.
These so-called expressions of "love" correspond to Victoria's abnormal behaviors.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You mean you did all this out of good intentions?

steps.speaker: Complaint from Medical Dept
steps.content: "Victoria added several bottles of liquid dietary supplement to my plate when I was away from the dining table. She refused to apologize when I found out, and even tried to spoon-feed me the food..."

steps.speaker: Report from Security Dept
steps.content: "Sinner No. 103 locked other Sinners in the detention room multiple times, using the blood crystals produced by her ability to block the keyholes."

steps.speaker: Nightingale's advice
steps.content: "She exhibits violent tendencies and attacks staff members with discarded syringes for no apparent reason. We recommend for her to be immediately expelled from the sterile ward and placed in confinement as punishment."
Victoria listens carefully to every accusation. To your incredulity, she looks pleased and relieved.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Finally, the actions I dedicate to "love" are being recognized!
Dedicate? Love? I don't understand.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That's fine. One day you'll understand. See, Sis Nightingale said I need to be locked up. Isn't that a response to my love?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Dedication begets rewards. Soon, I'll be surrounded by love again...
Immersed in her own thoughts, she simply babbles to herself in circles. For someone in this state of mind, it is pointless to pursue the matter any further...
Nightingale is not responding to your "love." On the contrary, she wants me to control your behavior.
Your so-called "love" already constitutes malicious harm and unlawful detainment towards others. Your actions have caused them suffering.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I don't understand what you mean, Chief... is everyone trying to reject Victoria's love?
It is as if she never expected to hear this answer. Her breathing quickens rapidly.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: How can it be... I... I had good intentions... why would they reject it?
Perhaps it's not a response to "love," but rather a rejection?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Rejection?
Yes. Your so-called "love" inflicted harm upon others. We hope you can stop this behavior.
She frowns and ponders for a moment, still unable to understand what you mean.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I don't understand... how could it be harmful... this is clearly Victoria's love...

options: You shouldn't ignore other people's feelings

choices.text: You shouldn't ignore other people's feelings

steps.content: Actions that cause others to suffer cannot be called "love" at all.
Perhaps you can express your "love" in a more acceptable way?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: You're lying! Cough cough...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content:
That's what Daddy taught me!
Daddy must be right... he must be...
You've triggered an emotional outburst from her. Even though she struggles to breathe, she refuses to give you the slightest chance to refute her.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy... That's how he loved Victoria.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content:
He locked me in the ward and forced me to take medicine... all kinds of medicine...
And taking injections... countless syringe holes...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: He... he did everything to protect me! This is love! You don't understand, none of you do! You're all wrong... only Daddy and I have the right love... cough cough!

options: So you were influenced by your father?
Calm down! Take a deep breath first

choices.text: So you were influenced by your father?
Calm down! Take a deep breath first

steps.content: Your father confined you to your home and harmed you in the name of "love," so you mistook similar behavior as expressions of "love"?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: How can it be a mistake?! I'm the only one who understands him!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Not only that, but I have come to realize even purer, more intense love on my own!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: ...Sigh... Never mind, you don't understand.
Victoria sighs and calms down again. She looks at you with pity in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It seems that only Daddy can appreciate my love... that feeling of being pierced in the chest—
She seems to be immersed in some warm memory. Her face flushes in an eerie and unsettling way.
The disappearance of Victoria's father, the tortured Corruptor body in the villa, the huge hole in the corpse's chest... You seem to have found answers to the remaining two pieces of evidence.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
Is this Corruptor corpse the result of your "love"?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: That's a photo of Daddy.
Victoria affectionately refers to the tormented and disfigured creature in the evidence as her father.

options: Why did your father turn into a Corruptor?

choices.text: Why did your father turn into a Corruptor?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Sob... I haven't seen Daddy for a long time. Sis Anne said he went somewhere far, far away. Will I be able to see Daddy back someday?
Mesmerized by the "masterpiece" in the evidence, she ignores your question completely.
Why did your father turn into a Corruptor?
Did you kill this Corruptor?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, can you give me this photo? It'd be nice if this photo kept me company while I wait for Daddy to return...
You are simply talking to a wall. Victoria scrutinizes the evidence, immersed in her thoughts.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But he didn't look like this before. It's all because we drank that strange medicine together to help me heal...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Fortunately, there are still traces of Victoria's love in the photo. You see...here, and here... I did all this.
Like a child, she shows off the fruits of her actions to you, proudly pointing to the pills overflowing from the Corruptor's mouth and the syringes all over its body.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Oh right, there's also this! Do you know what this is, Chief?
She points to the festering wound on the Corruptor's chest that spans more than ten centimeters in diameter.
Even though it's just a photo, you can practically smell the Corruptor's rotting corpse.

options: So this is your "most intense love"
These are fatal wounds that killed him

choices.text: So this is your "most intense love"
These are fatal wounds that killed him

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: See? I knew it! You can understand that this is my love, right Chief?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I knew from the moment you took me to the Bureau and locked me in the interrogation room that you'd understand me! Cough cough... because Chief, you're just like Daddy, you love Victoria the same way he did!
You were the one who described it as giving your father the most intense love, I was merely following your line of logic...
Your explanation falls on deaf ears. The girl babbles excitedly to herself.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief gave me a photo of Daddy and understood our love... what shall I do to repay you... what shall I do...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Not only that, but it's also my purest love...
She shows no grief over the subject of her father's death.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Look at how calm his expression is... he must be enjoying my love so much...
He's calm because he's dead...
You are already exhausted from explaining common sense over and over again, but the girl in front of you still lives in her own world.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Yes, I know that Daddy will only be away from me for a little while. But I have this photo that the Chief gave me, so Victoria isn't lonely.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, you gave me a photo of Daddy... what shall I do to repay you... what shall I do...
No need, it's just a piece of evidence...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Ah, I got it!
She interrupts you and stares straight ahead, but her pupils aren't focused on you. It's as if she is talking to the air behind you.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: How about I repay you with my most intense love, Chief...
Victoria bites her right hand without the slightest change on her face.
What are you doing?
A sharp blood crystal sprouts out of the wound and pierces towards you without warning!
You successfully dodge the first blood crystal, yet there's a second, then a third!
In this dark, tiny space, there is no place to hide. You feel a stinging pain as a blood crystal pierces through your left shoulder!
Sssss—
The girl with bloodied hands seems unable to hear your painful inhalation, and happily admires the new wound on your body.
You try to say something, but you're already going into limbo from blood loss. Fortunately, Adjutant Nightingale arrives promptly with help.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Quick! Stop the bleeding for the Chief!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Everyone else, take Victoria away and put her under strict lockdown! Do not give her any chance to attack the Chief!

You don't have the strength to open your eyes anymore, so you don't see Victoria's face when they escort her away. You only vaguely remember her innocent and excited tone of voice, like that of a five-or-six-year-old child.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Cough cough, can you feel it now? This is the most intense love!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief, do you... Do you love Victoria as well? Just like Daddy!
A split second before the crystal plunges into your heart, the shackles spring into action, halting the crystal an inch before you. It dissolves into liquid and splashes onto your uniform.

Victoria doesn't seem to care at all about your life hanging by a thread. She looks at the blood on your clothes in confusion, then looks at her hand. Blood gushes out of her wound, staining her entire right hand with blood.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: The bleeding... hasn't stopped?
She takes another bite at the original wound and extends her bloodstained right hand towards you.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: My blood won't turn into crystals anymore?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why did this have to happen now... I-I wanted to show the Chief my love... oh why...
She pulls and squeezes her wound, spurting more blood on her white coat, white skirt, and pale thighs. The contrast of colors is glaring.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Love, my love for Chief... why is it not there any more? Cough cough cough!

options: Because the shackles have limited your abilities

choices.text: Because the shackles have limited your abilities

steps.content: You don't have the ability to hurt others with your blood now. I won't allow you to make more mistakes.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Shackles? You used shackles on me to limit my abilities?
Yes. I prefer not to control Sinners too harshly, but given the emergency just now...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Hahahaha...
She suddenly bursts out laughing, letting out a sigh of relief as she gently hugs herself with her blood-stained hands.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I thought that after Daddy left, I was all alone... It turns out that this love never left.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content:
Because I just received it—this is confinement only for me, right?
In that moment, your gaze, your thoughts, they exist for Victoria alone...
No. It's to stop you from harming others.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy, did you see it? Chief is keeping me company just like you did...
Her voice grows weaker and weaker. You notice that the wound on her right hand is still gushing a lot of blood.
It was just one bite. Why is it so serious?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy said that Victoria was a child chosen by the gods and would bleed non-stop if she got wounded.
Victoria's lips begin to turn white.
Nightingale, arrange for medical staff to treat her wounds now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Okay. Help is on the way.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: You want to heal me, just like Daddy, right?... How wonderful.
Seconds after you hang up the comms system, footsteps echo outside the door.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Ah... Someone... is coming to interfere with our love...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: No, they want to separate us again... cough cough!

The medical staff enter the interrogation room in an orderly manner. They ignore Victoria's feeble resistance and give her some basic bandaging. But when they try to take her away for further examinations, Victoria refuses to get up.

options: Persuade her to cooperate with the treatment

choices.text: Persuade her to cooperate with the treatment

steps.content: Today's interrogation is already over. You have lost a lot of blood. Go with them for some examinations. I will also restore your abilities.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content:
So these shackles only for Victoria, they're coming to an end... Will I be interrogated again after that?
Will you, continue to imprison me?
...The source of your criminal and abnormal behavior is basically clear now. There is no need to continue the interrogation.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: It must be because they disturbed us. That's why you took back the shackles, right?
Victoria glances warily at the medical staff. Evidently, she is still in her own world.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: If it were just the two of us, our love could go on...
You misunderstood. The shackles have nothing to do with "love."

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I'll be waiting for you, waiting for a chance to be alone with you, waiting for you to shackle me again... just like I'll be waiting for Daddy to come back.
But Victoria, your father...
He's not coming back.
